title: tFold designs binding antibodies against four defined antigens
summary: Tencent researchers generated antibodies against influenza hemagglutinin, PD-1, PD-L1 and SARS-CoV-2 RBD, followed by phage-display screening and SPR characterization. Anti-SC2RBD-H330 showed neutralization IC50 of 0.42 nM. Screening remained extensive, and some confident epitope predictions failed competition tests. The date represents initial journal publication, preceding the January 19, 2026 version of record; a tFold precursor was posted February 8, 2024.
organization: Tencent AI for Life Sciences Lab

evidence.tested: Binding and competition assays on generated antibodies; RBD-antibody neutralization.
evidence.unknown: Separate supplements and independent replication not assessed. First-public dates of individual journal experiments were not established by precursor version comparison.
evidence.ai_role: Generates CDR sequences and predicts complexes for structure-guided filtering.
